correction.method: Re-derived from the preserved d, z, m seeds with FIPS 203 Algorithms 16-18 (mlkem.mjs sha256 73a7d3bd25ad78bd8061535bf9a306228d6d34e09f7663870b0b5e579ae58808); hostile cases re-derived by applying each original mutation to the corrected base; expected values recomputed; independently checked with kyber-py (check_corrected.py).
